subject: phase-sections
kind: deliver
result: pass
revision: 78548da
evidence:
- Red run (before implementing). Model tests: 4 new tests failed with the model change stashed (`-k "signoff or sign_off or phase_detail"`: 4 failed). App tests: with the model done but no app code, `-k "phase or header or fold or progress or footer or table_lists"` gave 29 failed, 10 passed.
- Green: the acceptance command `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py tests/test_dashboard_model.py -q` gave 166 passed.
- Extra suites `tests/test_tmux_integration.py tests/test_e2e_dashboard.py tests/test_dashboard_launcher.py`: 20 passed in 2 of 3 consecutive runs. The 3rd run failed `test_e2e_side_pane_and_status_follow_every_lifecycle_step`. The pane printed "No artifact store for ..." and timed out waiting for the side pane.
- That e2e test passes alone (3 of 3 runs), and the launcher/store code is untouched. I believe it is an intermittent race in the test, not caused by this change, but I did not confirm that on the baseline. Baseline 75e530c passed 20/20 on its single run.
- `test_the_task_table_has_focus_on_load` flaked after the table gained more work. I fixed it by calling `focus_tasks()` directly in `apply` as well as after refresh. It then passed 10 of 10 runs.
- Implementation. Model (`scripts/dashboard_model.py`): `PhaseRow` gained `id` and `awaiting_signoff`. A non-done phase awaits sign-off when it has open tasks and every open task has acceptances that all have a passing latest check, with at least one manual check unsigned. New `PhaseDetail` and `load_phase_detail` carry the body, decisions, constraints and tasks of one phase.
- App (`scripts/dashboard_app.py`): `section_rows` groups the table under phase headers in ordinal order. In-progress and awaiting phases expand. Done and planned phases collapse. More than two done phases fold the older ones into an "N earlier phases done" row. Enter or click toggles a header or the fold row. `p` opens `PhaseDetailScreen` for the cursor row. The progress bar and label now cover the whole effort. The footer is compact so the new `p phase` key fits at 60 columns.
- Phase visibility: a phase shows only if it has tasks matching the current tab and filter. The All tab with no text filter also shows empty phases. Expansion state is kept per effort and survives refreshes.
- README: added a layout paragraph and key-table rows for enter and `p`.
- Existing test edits (small, local): `_titles` now skips header rows. Several row-index assertions shifted by one header row. Done-tab tests press enter to expand the collapsed done phase. The footer test lists the new "phase" key. The progress test expects effort-wide counts (1 of 4). The "all" tab order is now by phase. New fixture `phased`. No shared fixtures in `conftest.py` or `helpers.py` were touched.
- The Done tab shows only collapsed headers until you press enter. I kept the spec literally, so the user may want to revisit that.
- `--once` output is still an ungrouped table.
observations: Textual's DataTable click handler and my click handler both fire. The click handler therefore calls `event.prevent_default()` and moves the cursor itself, so a header toggles only once.
root_cause:
verdict: pass
metrics: acceptance command 166 passed, 0 failed; extra suites 20 passed with 1 intermittent e2e failure
claim: Tasks group into collapsible phase sections with fold, toggle by key and click, phase detail, awaiting sign-off, and effort-wide progress, and the focus fix 2d1a3be still works (arrows move the cursor, enter opens a task).
needs_human: false
